title: 第824章 我是散修但也略懂一点人脉第823章 这打拳的小子不过如此我一招足以
slug: 三天大成了绝世剑仙童养夫
content_zh:
姜玄目光在两人之间来回扫了一下，脸上浮现出一抹温和的笑意。
“叶道友哪里的话，这噬魂蛭寄生的傀儡本就不惧疼痛不畏生死，寻常同阶修士遇上它们都会头疼不已，几位能毫发无损地全部拿下，已经相当不易了。”
他说完顿了顿，话锋一转。
“对了，在下还不知叶道友师承何处，二位年纪轻轻便有如此实力，想来应当是出身名门吧？”
叶天澜摆手笑了笑：“姜兄抬举了，我们哪算什么名门出身，不过是小地方来的散修罢了。”
正在后面充当背景板喝水的敕凤差点没有仰头一口喷出来。
姜玄眉头微挑，显然不信。
“叶道友莫不是在说笑不成，以道友这般身手，怎么可能是散修？”
“真不是谦虚。”叶天澜语气真诚得很，连他自己都快信了。
妖妃月又没有带他拜山门，他可不就是散修吗？
当然，你要是非说我是神朝公主，圣地圣女的人的话，那就另当别论了。
在下也略能摇一点助力来。
“实不相瞒，我们其实不是本地人。”
此言一出，青鸾宗七人的目光齐齐闪了一下。
姜玄身后那个年轻弟子原本正百无聊赖地打量着地上那些尸体，听见这话忽然抬起头来，眼神里多了一丝别样的意味。
另外几个弟子也下意识交换了一个眼神，虽然谁都没有开口，但空气中那种微妙的氛围已经变了。
姜玄的眉梢压下来，脸上的笑意还在，但语气里多了几分追问的味道。
“不是本地人？那叶道友是从何处而来的？”
“玄夜联邦。”
叶天澜随口答道，然后又像是想起了什么，补充道。

“不过也不准确。我们几个其实是从下界飞升上来的，只是碰巧落在了玄夜联邦的地界上，在那儿待了一阵子才往这边赶。”
他语气随意。
“听说赤耀联邦这边要办百族大战，只要参加比赛就能得到机缘，运气好的话还能拿到身份加入大势力。”
“我们寻思着反正也没地方可去，就千里迢迢赶过来碰碰运气，没想到还没到赛场呢，先碰上了这档子事。”
他把双手一摊，脸上带着几分恰到好处的无奈。
“这不，人生地不熟的，连路都认不全，稀里糊涂就拐到这座空城里来了。”
演武场上安静了片刻。
然后那个年轻弟子没忍住，从鼻子里发出一声极轻的嗤笑。
旁边几个师弟也纷纷露出了然的神情，眼底最后一丝忌惮在这一刻彻底消散干净。
搞了半天，原来竟然是从下界飞升上来的泥腿子。
难怪修为稀松平常，难怪连几个法相后期的傀儡都要拼命。
下界那种贫瘠之地能修炼到法相境已经算是烧高香了，放到上界来，这点修为能翻出什么浪花？
还参加百族大战？
就这水平还想拿名次？
能在海选阶段不被淘汰就算他们走了狗屎运。
姜玄愣了一瞬，然后笑了。
那笑容跟他之前挂在脸上的温和完全不同，是一种卸下了所有防备之后的自嘲之笑。
content_en:
Jiang Xuan glanced back and forth between the two of them, and a gentle smile appeared on his face.
"Fellow Daoist Ye, these soul-eating leech-parasitic puppets are not afraid of pain or life and death. Normally, monks of the same level will have a headache when they encounter them. It is quite difficult for a few of them to take them all down without any damage."
After he finished speaking, he paused and changed the subject.
"By the way, I still don't know where Ye Daoyou learned from him. You two have such strength at such a young age. You must be from a famous family, right?"
Ye Tianlan waved his hand and smiled: "Brother Jiang, you are so complimentary. We are not from a famous family. We are just casual cultivators from a small place."
Zhi Feng, who was drinking water as a backdrop, almost raised his head and squirted out.
Jiang Xuan raised his eyebrows slightly, obviously not believing it.
"Could Fellow Daoist Ye be joking? With Fellow Daoist's skills, how can he be a casual cultivator?"
"It's really not modest." Ye Tianlan's tone was so sincere that even he almost believed it.
Yao Feiyue didn't take him to worship at the mountain gate. Isn't he just a casual cultivator?
Of course, if you insist on saying that I am a princess of the Divine Dynasty or a saint of the Holy Land, then that is a different story.
I can give you a little bit of help.
"To be honest, we are not locals."
As soon as these words came out, the eyes of the seven members of the Qingluan Sect flashed.
The young disciple behind Jiang Xuan was looking at the corpses on the ground boredly. Hearing these words, he suddenly raised his head, with a different meaning in his eyes.
Several other disciples also exchanged glances subconsciously. Although no one spoke, the subtle atmosphere in the air had changed.
Jiang Xuan's eyebrows lowered, the smile on his face was still there, but there was a hint of questioning in his tone.
"Not a local? Where did Fellow Daoist Ye come from?"
"Xuan Ye Federation."
Ye Tianlan answered casually, and then added as if he remembered something.
"But that's not accurate. The few of us actually ascended from the lower world, but happened to land on the borders of the Xuanye Federation. We stayed there for a while before rushing here."
His tone was casual.
"I heard that the Scarlet Yao Federation is going to hold a war of hundreds of races. As long as you participate in the competition, you will get a chance. If you are lucky, you can get the status to join a big force."
"We thought there was nowhere to go anyway, so we came all the way here to try our luck. Unexpectedly, we encountered this kind of thing before we even got to the stadium."
He spread his hands with a look of helplessness on his face.
"No, you're unfamiliar with the place. You don't even know the road, so you turned around and ended up in this empty city."
The martial arts arena was quiet for a moment.
Then the young disciple couldn't hold back and let out a very light sneer from his nose.
The junior brothers next to him also showed understanding expressions, and the last trace of fear in their eyes completely dissipated at this moment.
After working on it for a long time, it turned out to be a clay leg that had ascended from the lower world.
No wonder the cultivation level is ordinary, no wonder even a few puppets in the late stage of the Dharma phase have to work hard.
Being able to cultivate to the realm of Dharma in a barren land like the lower realm is already considered a high level of incense. If you put it in the upper realm, what kind of waves can you make with this level of cultivation?
Still participating in the war of hundreds of tribes?
Do you still want to get ranked at this level?
If they don't get eliminated in the audition stage, they are just lucky.
Jiang Xuan was stunned for a moment, and then smiled.
That smile was completely different from the gentleness that had appeared on his face before. It was a self-deprecating smile after all defenses had been removed.
